en.name: Team Wendy EXFIL Ballistic Helmet (Arctic Camo)
en.description: One of the most recent tactical ballistic helmets with extensive customization capabilities. The EXFIL LTP (Lightweight, Tactical, Polymer) bump helmet provides impact protection for maritime environments and a stable, comfortable platform for mounting night vision and other accessories. The built-in NVG shroud utilizes an integrated Wilcox machined aluminum shroud insert. Arctic Camo version.
